product.trigger: The member advances a work item after completing the current stage
product.outcome: Every active platform shows the same accepted canonical stage and revision
product.authority: The server authenticates the actor and atomically repeats authorization, revision, transition, and persistence policy

recovery.STALE_REVISION: Replace the optimistic projection with the canonical item and explain that newer work won
recovery.INVALID_TRANSITION: Preserve the item and show the allowed next actions
recovery.WRONG_AGGREGATE: Discard the malformed command and record a contract failure

concurrency.write: expected revision plus stable operation ID
concurrency.optimism: project once, roll back exactly, then replace with the canonical response
concurrency.offline: queue intent as unconfirmed and replay against the expected revision

presentation.accessibilityIntent: Expose stage and recovery as text; keep one keyboard and screen-reader operable primary action
presentation.nativeFreedom: Each platform chooses controls, navigation, layout, lifecycle restoration, and capability adapters

rollout.compatibility: Server accepts the prior and current capsule epoch until active-client evidence permits retirement
